mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${tableName} ( `id` bigint(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'id', `device_id` bigint(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '设备id', `param_id` bigint(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '参数id', `param_value` decimal(64,8) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '参数值', `param_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '参数值记录时间', `create_by` bigint(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建人', `create_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建时间', `update_by` bigint(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '更新人', `update_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '更新时间', `del_flag` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '删除标志(0:正常,1:已删除)', PRIMARY KEY (`id`) USING BTREE, UNIQUE KEY `combin_index` (`device_id`,`param_id`,`param_time`) USING BTREE ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='参数数据信息表-历史数据';
